title: Cameroon Warns of Admission Scams as Doctoral Programs Resume
summary: Callers posing as university staff asked PhD applicants for money to 'guarantee' admission while results were pending.

title: FAKE: CNPS Warns of Internship Scam Charging Fees for Fake Placements
summary: A caller posing as CNPS HR offered internships for a 9,800 FCFA fee, then kept postponing the start date.

title: Beware Fake BEAC Statement Claiming CFA50 Billion Project Funding
summary: A forged BEAC press release announced a 50 billion FCFA fund for individual projects, used to lure people into sharing data or paying.

title: Beware of Fake MINFOPRA Job Drive Promising 24,000 Youth Hires
summary: A fake 'special recruitment' memo for 24,000 graduates asked applicants to email ID cards and diplomas to a Gmail address.

title: BEAC Warns of Fake CFA 100 Billion Tender Circulating
summary: A fake BEAC tender offering 100 billion FCFA of project financing circulated online.

title: Beware Fake Social Media Accounts Impersonate Finance Minister Louis Paul Motaze
summary: Fake LinkedIn profiles using the Finance Minister's name and photo posted official-looking updates to build credibility.

title: Public Service: New Fake Job Scam Targets The Youth
summary: A fabricated radio-press release announced a 'Special Youth Emergency Plan' recruitment of 6,000 and collected fees through a fake email.

title: Beware, Minpostel Has Not Launched Recruitment for 965 Young People
summary: A WhatsApp 'announcement' of 965 IT and electrotechnician posts used a fake email to collect applications and upfront fees.

title: Fraud Alert: Public Servants Are Targeted in Integration File Scam
summary: A caller posing as ministry staff asked teachers with pending integration files for money to 'speed up' processing.

title: Mass Recruitment at Razel Cameroun? No, yet another job scam
summary: A fake press release with the company logo announced 800 construction jobs and collected CVs by email.

title: Beware! CNPS issues scam alert targeting pension recipients
summary: Callers posing as CNPS staff told benefit recipients to transfer the money they had just received to mobile money accounts.

title: Beware! Dr. Paul Fokam has no accounts on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter
summary: Fake profiles of a well-known banker invited users into 'business partnerships'.

title: Beware of this new job scam
summary: A fake memo for 117 airport security jobs asked applicants for 30,000 FCFA in 'medical examination' fees.

title: Beware of the scammers impersonating Ministry of Health officials on social media
summary: Scammers used the names, titles and contacts of senior health ministry officials on social media; victims filed complaints.

title: Beware of phone calls from scammers supposedly acting on behalf the MINESUP or the MINFI
summary: Callers posing as ministry agents demanded large payments to approve career files and salary-arrears claims.

title: Beware of the scammers pretending to be private agents acting on behalf of the Cameroonian embassy in Belgium
summary: Social media posts using embassy staff photos offered to obtain national ID cards for diaspora members through 'private agents'.

title: Beware of the alleged CCAA job ad currently circulating on social media
summary: A fake ad for 450 security agents asked applicants to email files and pay 20,000 FCFA for a medical exam.

title: MINJEC warns of fake job ads supposedly from the MINJEC and the MINFOPRA
summary: Scammers posing as ministry officials promised internships at the youth ministry.

title: Beware of the fake national employment fund's job ad seeking 1200 young graduates
summary: A fake FNE ad for 1,200 part-time teachers collected CVs and IDs and then asked for processing fees.

title: Beware of the supposed customs auction announcement requesting advance payments
summary: Fake customs auction notices asked the public to pay in advance for goods to be auctioned.

title: Beware, scammers are impersonating Minister of Social Affairs on social media
summary: Posts falsely claimed the minister asked regional staff to contribute money for her mother's funeral.

title: Beware of the fake job ad recruiting 400 young graduates for the French embassy in Cameroon
summary: A fake ad claimed the French embassy urgently needed 400 graduates for various posts.

title: Beware of fake Facebook profiles posing as the Chief of Staff of the National Navy
summary: Fake Facebook profiles of the Navy's Chief of Staff were used to lure the public.

title: Beware, some individuals pose as the prefect of Mfoundi to swindle
summary: Callers posing as the Mfoundi prefect extracted money from citizens by phone.

title: Beware: A new job scam claims Carrefour is recruiting 234 young people in Cameroon
summary: A fake note announced 234 retail jobs with applications by email, QR code or link.

title: Beware of the Facebook phishing scheme pretending to recruit staff for Carrefour Cameroon
summary: A Facebook job ad link collected personal details and asked applicants for their Facebook login.

title: Orange Money alerts about a fake Facebook page bearing its name
summary: A fake Orange Money Facebook page promised money, phones and cars to users who shared its posts, then contacted them privately.

title: Beware! The aviation authority is not currently recruiting 310 safety officers
summary: A fake communique for 310 safety officers asked candidates to pay 20,000 FCFA in medical fees.

title: Beware! Camrail is not currently recruiting
summary: A fake ad announced 150 assistant conductor jobs at Camrail stations.

title: End of year exams: Conac warns of online scams
summary: Fake accounts sold 'leaked' official exam papers, paid by mobile money deposit.

title: Beware, the Ministry of Mines has only two official websites
summary: Five lookalike ministry websites appeared; one showed a private mobile number as the ministry contact.

title: Beware of the fake recruitment notices published on social media on behalf of the General manager of the SCDP
summary: Fake LinkedIn and Facebook profiles of the company's head posted job notices and collected 11,500 FCFA per file.

title: Beware, scammers are trying to get people's bank details over the phone
summary: Callers posing as bank advisers during COVID restrictions asked for account numbers and card codes.

title: Beware, malicious individuals continue to scam people on Orange Money
summary: Callers said the victim's Orange Money account was 'not up to date' and had them enter a code, then emptied the account.

title: Beware of the fake job ad recruiting 1,600 agents on behalf of the Pronadel
summary: An 'NGO' posted a fake recruitment of 1,600 communal agents across the 10 regions.

title: Beware, fraudsters have created fake Facebook accounts using the name of BEAC's governor
summary: Fake Facebook accounts in the BEAC governor's name were set up to scam the public.

title: It's a scam! You won't earn CFA10,000 by dialing the USSD code #237# via your MTN number
summary: A viral message promised 10,000 FCFA to MTN users who dialled a USSD code.

title: Beware, the national employment fund is not currently recruiting
summary: A fake FNE recruitment of 500 young people asked 15,000 FCFA application fees.

title: The public administration is not recruiting teachers for CFA14,000
summary: A fake recruitment of nursery and primary teachers asked candidates to pay 14,000 FCFA.

title: Chamber of trade warns against scammers claiming to belong to its Office for permits
summary: Fake agents of a non-existent 'office for permits' demanded payment from foreign firms for import/export permits.

title: Buca E-Ticket: A fake Facebook page that sells digital bus tickets
summary: A fake Facebook page sold 'e-tickets' for a bus company, paid by mobile money to personal numbers.

title: A scam claims that job seekers must pay to benefit from the FNE's services
summary: Fake online ads charged job seekers to 'register' for the free public employment service and collected their data.

title: No, the ministry of finance is not hiring 300 agents
summary: A fake MINFI notice for 300 finance jobs, full of spelling errors, used a non-government email address.

title: Beware of scammers who claim they can recruit people into the civil service on behalf of Minister Joseph Le
summary: Scammers claimed they could place people directly in the civil service for 250,000 FCFA 'insurance fees', backed by a forged statement.

title: Application fees for recruitment in Cameroonian customs cost XAF14500...or so claims this scam
summary: A fake customs recruitment asked 14,500 FCFA application fees, with a WhatsApp number and a lookalike website.

title: Beware of fake online banks!
summary: Emails using a bank's branding asked customers to 'update' details by reply or through a fake bank site.

title: A scam claims that Dovv is hiring female salespersons
summary: A fake notice with a supermarket's logo and stamp collected CVs, ID copies and full photos of young women.

title: Beware! Cameroon's civil aviation authority is not recruiting 310 safety agents
summary: A fake communique for 310 security agents asked about 35,000 FCFA in fees.

title: A new scam promises Carrefour coupons
summary: A WhatsApp message offered a 500 euro coupon via a survey link that required sharing the message with 20 contacts.

title: Chan 2020: The minister of sports warns against fake job offers relayed on social networks
summary: Fake, highly paid job offers for the CHAN football tournament targeted unemployed youth.

title: Beware! Don't reply to job ads posted by the Fake Facebook page @unicef.canada.officiel
summary: A fake UNICEF Canada Facebook page posted job ads.

title: FAUX, ARNAQUE : CE LIEN NE VIENT PAS DE CAMTEL
summary: A long link shared in WhatsApp groups used CAMTEL's name and a quiz to promise prizes and harvest personal data.

title: How social media has influenced Ponzi schemes amid the Anglophone crisis
summary: Ponzi schemes spread on social media in the North West region promised high returns and collapsed, ruining later investors.

title: Faux, la Douane Camerounaise n'organisera pas une vente aux enchères des véhicules
summary: A fake customs vehicle auction asked people to send their ID on WhatsApp and pay 100,000 FCFA registration by mobile money.

title: NON, le MINFOPRA n'a pas lancé le recrutement spécial de 5000 enseignants
summary: A 'forwarded many times' WhatsApp post announced a special recruitment of 5,000 teachers.

title: Faux : CAMRAIL n'a lancé aucun recrutement de 110 aides cheminots et de 90 contrôleurs
summary: A fabricated Camrail communique for 200 railway jobs circulated on WhatsApp to extort money from applicants.

title: Non ! La station-service Neptune Oil n'a pas ouvert le recrutement de 1170 employés
summary: A fake notice for 1,170 petrol station jobs went viral in a Facebook job group of 38,000 members.

title: Attention, This account offering registration for DV Lottery is fake
summary: A fake DV Lottery registration link led through several malicious sites.

title: Faux : le Programme alimentaire n'a lancé aucun recrutement
summary: A WhatsApp link advertised '65,000 jobs' at the World Food Programme to lure job seekers.

title: Faux ! Ce communiqué annonçant une plateforme de production des CNI et passeports en ligne n'est pas de la DGSN
summary: A fake 'DGSN Cameroun' Facebook page announced an online ID card and passport platform.

title: Understanding cyber scam in Cameroon: the SUNRUN case
summary: Get-rich-quick platforms like Sunrun collapsed with about 20 billion FCFA of investors' money.

title: Faux ! Aucun frais de commission de 5000 F.Cfa n'est demandé pour le concours de la police 2025
summary: A poster with the police logo demanded a 5,000 FCFA 'commission' from police concours candidates.

title: CANULAR : Le Premier Ministre n'a approuvé aucun programme de Fortuix Agent
summary: A sponsored deepfake video of the Prime Minister promoted an 'AI' platform: invest 150,000 FCFA to earn 1.76 million a month.

title: Faux, Paul Biya n'offre pas 150 000 FCFA à chaque Camerounais
summary: A viral Facebook post promised 150,000 FCFA to every citizen during the election, with a link to an external site.

title: Financial scams
summary: The Finance Ministry banned unlicensed crypto 'investment' operators collecting public savings with unrealistic returns.

title: VRAI: Ceci est un modus operandi des arnaqueurs pour siphonner les comptes Mobile Money
summary: Confirmed by MTN: the scammer starts a withdrawal on the victim's account, then calls about a 'mistaken' transfer so the victim types the PIN.

title: FAUX : Le ministère de la Défense n'a pas publié la liste finale de recrutement de l'armée pour 2026
summary: A fake communique claimed gendarmerie concours results were out, while deliberations were still ongoing.

title: CANULAR : Le FNE n'a pas lancé de recrutement de 1 732 enseignants vacataires
summary: A fake FNE tender for 1,732 part-time teachers asked applicants to email documents to a non-FNE address.

title: Cameroun-arnaque : de faux agents d'Orange vident les comptes des abonnés Orange Money
summary: People in Orange-branded outfits in Douala and Yaoundé offered street 'account resets' during a fake security campaign, then emptied the accounts.

title: Alerte : 'Jete' nouvelle technique d'arnaque sur Orange Money
summary: The scammer deposits 2,000 to 5,000 FCFA, then starts a withdrawal; the victim types the PIN 'to check the balance' and approves the withdrawal.

title: Cameroun: La lutte contre la fraude comme gage de sécurité des transactions mobile MoMo
summary: MTN described scammers firing withdrawal requests at many numbers hoping someone types their PIN; its fix *126*15# blocks others from starting withdrawals.

title: Escroquerie : Une nouvelle forme d'arnaque par Orange money et MoMo
summary: Thieves snatch a phone in the street and message every contact that the owner is in hospital and needs money sent to a new number.

title: Arnaque via Mobile Money: la riposte du Ministre des Postes et Télécommunications
summary: After a surge of complaints, the telecom minister met MTN, Orange and Camtel over fraud using social engineering and SIM reprogramming.

title: Yaoundé : de faux agents Eneo arnaquent les populations, cinq personnes interpellées
summary: Men in fake ENEO uniforms with forged bills and cut-off notices demanded 20,000 to 30,000 FCFA from households in Yaoundé to avoid a power cut; some also scouted homes for burglaries.

title: Cameroun – Alerte WhatsApp : une nouvelle arnaque vide les comptes
summary: Urgent WhatsApp messages with a link take over the victim's account; the scammers then ask the victim's contacts for money.
example_message: Ton compte sera bloqué / Tu as été sélectionné / Urgent, confirme ici

title: Quelle est l'arnaque du code à 6 chiffres dont il faut se méfier ?
summary: A hacked contact asks the victim to forward a 6-digit code received by SMS; the code is the WhatsApp login code, and the victim's account is taken over next.

title: Prêt d'argent en ligne : ces applications qui transforment vos contacts en otages
summary: Loan apps installed outside the Play Store take contacts and camera access, pay out about half the amount while charging the full sum in 7 days, then harass and threaten the borrower's contacts.

title: Cameroun : le gouvernement ouvre la chasse aux fintechs illégales
summary: A Finance Ministry communique of 5 May 2025 banned unlicensed platforms offering credit, fund collection and money transfers, and announced a blacklist.

title: Fausse vente aux enchères de véhicules : un réseau camerounais arnaque des Guinéens
summary: A network based in Cameroon forged customs auction notices and signatures to sell non-existent vehicles to buyers in Guinea.

title: Liyeplimal / Global Investment Trading
summary: An 'investment' network active until 2022 promised 200% a year plus recruitment bonuses; its token collapsed and about 300,000 people in some 40 countries lost money.

title: Cameroun – Arnaques en ligne : les nouvelles stratégies des escrocs (romance)
summary: A scammer posing as a soldier built an online relationship with a victim in Bamenda, then asked for help 'receiving a package'.

title: Cameroun – Arnaques en ligne : les nouvelles stratégies des escrocs (fake agency)
summary: A fake agency promising jobs in NGOs and multinationals charged 25,000 FCFA 'file fees' for interviews in Douala, then cut contact.

title: Cameroun – Arnaques en ligne : les nouvelles stratégies des escrocs (urgent money)
summary: Callers posing as a bank agent, a delivery company or a relative claim a blocked parcel or an accident and demand money immediately.

title: Attention, des arnaqueurs déguisent de simples SMS sous forme de notifications de transfert d'argent par Mobile Money
summary: An ordinary SMS written to look like a Mobile Money credit notice, followed by a call saying the money was sent by mistake and must be returned. The real notice comes from the operator, not from a personal number.
example_message: Mobile Money, vous avez reçu 56 500 FCFA de [NAME] ([PHONE:677-cvbmej]) le 2018-11-23. 10 : 13 :31. Transaction Id : [TXN_ID].

title: Mobile Money Scam: Fraudsters Multiply Strategies
summary: A fake 45,000 FCFA credit SMS followed by a call asking to 'resend' the money, and prize SMS asking winners to call a number. A victim in Douala lost 100,000 FCFA.

title: Arnaques au Mobile money : revoilà les escrocs
summary: A caller posing as an operator agent says the account password has a problem; an accomplice then asks the victim to validate an 'OK' prompt, which approves a withdrawal. Others send repeated withdrawal prompts hoping the victim approves one in a hurry.

title: Des individus tentent d'arnaquer en se faisant passer pour l'opérateur MTN Cameroon
summary: Messages in MTN's name told subscribers they had won a promotion and must transfer money to collect it. MTN said it never asks for money to release winnings.

title: Suite aux plaintes d'arnaques, Orange Cameroun renforce la sécurité des transactions Mobile Money
summary: Three tricks behind a wave of complaints: withdrawal prompts the customer never started, calls from fake Orange agents 'updating' accounts to get the PIN, and fake 'sent by mistake' refund requests.

title: MTN Mobile Money : failles de sécurité, fraude et combat judiciaire d'un client camerounais
summary: A fake MTN agent asked the victim to read out codes shown on screen 'to verify identity'. They were one-time codes that linked the scammer's phone to the account; 117,000 of a 118,000 FCFA balance was withdrawn. The victim filed a police complaint.

title: Orange Money démasque une arnaque et met en garde contre des applications frauduleuses
summary: An .apk shared in WhatsApp groups promised almost free internet bundles and asked for the Orange Money PIN during setup.

title: Alerte sur les arnaques autour des transferts d'argent par téléphone
summary: Scammers write from a relative's WhatsApp or number asking for urgent help. Orange Cameroun's advice: call the person before sending anything.

title: Arnaques : les abonnés d'Orange Cameroun dans le viseur
summary: Prize SMS from a foreign number, and fake alerts about relatives in accidents, pushed people to call back and buy credit for international calls that never connected.
example_message: Bravo, vous avez gagné 10 000 Euros et un voyage pour la France

title: Cybercriminalité : deux suspects aux arrêts
summary: Fake ticket-booking platforms took payment for flights, then drained the buyers' Mobile Money accounts: one civil servant paid 19,000 FCFA for a Yaoundé-Douala ticket and lost 230,000. Gendarmes in Yaoundé say the network took over 50 million FCFA.

title: Arnaque à la tontine en ligne : une Camerounaise perd 1,5 million FCFA
summary: An online tontine of 15 members paying 100,000 FCFA a month. The member placed last never got her 1.5 million: the admin, who was also treasurer, blocked her and the payment numbers went dead.

title: Escroquerie en ligne au Cameroun : quand internet devient un piège
summary: Cases from Yaoundé: a Facebook 'investment' that took 100,000 FCFA then asked for more; an Instagram romance with 'visa fees' of 200,000 FCFA and the same photos reused on other victims; sellers who take a deposit and vanish.

title: Attention, MTN Cameroon n'offre pas 10 000 FCFA à toute personne souscrivant au code #237#
summary: A message riding on MTN's COVID-19 relief campaign promised 10,000 FCFA to anyone who dialled #237#. MTN denied owning the code.
example_message: MTN Cameroon offre 10 000 FCFA à toute personne souscrivant au code #237#

title: Cameroun. Même en prison, ils continuent d'arnaquer: la fraude au SMS en toute liberté
summary: SMS asking a 'friend' for urgent money, traced to inmates of Yaoundé Central Prison using smuggled phones. Another victim lost 130,000 FCFA after an SMS offering to deposit 80,000 FCFA into her account.
example_message: Bonjour cher ami ! S'il te plait envoie-moi urgemment 30.000 Fcfa.

title: Fintechs illégales : prêts express, taux abusifs, les dérives cachées des applications de microcrédit
summary: A borrower asked for 16,000 FCFA, received 10,400 and owed 16,104 a week later, then got calls every five minutes; another borrower's colleagues were told they were guarantors and would be reported to the central bank.
example_message: Our interest is of 104 FCFA only, the 6,000 FCFA, it's for the application

title: La gendarmerie aux trousses des arnaqueurs via le téléphone mobile
summary: Callers posing as old friends sold a Cameroonian in Belgium a gold mining deal in Batouri; he sent 15 million FCFA by mobile money. Two suspects were arrested in Yaoundé.

title: Concours CIMAP Kribi 2026 : un faux avis de concours
summary: A fake training concours notice asked for 5,000 FCFA in fees plus copies of diplomas and ID cards. The Port Authority of Kribi disowned it on 3 June 2026.

title: Cameroun. «Mon compte a été vidé»: la cyberpiraterie prend le large
summary: A student entered her details on a fake scholarship site shared on WhatsApp; her WhatsApp and Orange Money accounts were taken over and emptied before she could withdraw 500,000 FCFA. Hijacked accounts then ask contacts for urgent money.

title: CANULAR : Orange Money n'offre pas 15 000 francs CFA à ses abonnés pour son 15e anniversaire
summary: A survey site promised 15,000 FCFA for Orange Money's 15th anniversary; after four questions and a 'pick a box' game, people were told to share it to 5 groups or 20 friends to claim the gift.
example_message: Félicitations ! Orange Money – Cadeau du 15e anniversaire. Répondez à ce sondage pour avoir une chance de gagner 15 000 F CFA

title: CANULAR : Cette campagne de recrutement de la SCDP est frauduleuse
summary: A Facebook post announced 105 jobs at the national petroleum depot company with an email address that is not the company's. SCDP's HR director called it fraudulent.

title: CANULAR : Le port autonome de Douala n'a pas initié ce recrutement
summary: A fake recruitment notice in the Port of Douala's name listed jobs and documents to send to an unofficial email. The port denied it.
example_message: Le Port Autonome de Douala (PAD) informe les jeunes Camerounais et toutes les personnes intéressées du lancement d'une nouvelle campagne de recrutement visant à renforcer ses différents services. (...) Les opportunités concernent notamment différents domaines : Administratifs (Secrétaire et Assistant RH), Maintenance (Électrique, Mécanique, etc.), Des Agents Manœuvres, Des Agents de sécurité, Agents de sécurité environnementale (QHSE)

title: CANULAR : Cet avis de recrutement du complexe Santa Lucia est frauduleux
summary: A post offered 509 holiday and pre-employment internships at Santa Lucia supermarkets in Douala and Yaoundé. The regional director called it a scam.
example_message: 509 jeunes camerounais recherchés ! Le Complexe Santa Lucia lance son recrutement pour les stages de vacances 2026, stages académiques et stages Pré-Emploi dans plusieurs agences de Douala et Yaoundé

title: CANULAR : Cette annonce de recrutement de 1000 auditeurs libres dans la fonction publique est fausse
summary: A forged ministerial draft order announced direct civil-service recruitment of 1,000 teacher-training graduates. The Minister called it a scam; the order's number, date and stamp layout did not match real ones.
example_message: Cameroun: Projets d'arrêtés portant ouverture des concours directs pour le recrutement dans la fonction publique de 1000 auditeurs libres issus des Écoles Normales (ENS/ENSET)

title: CANULAR : BOCOM Petroleum SA n'a pas lancé de campagne de recrutement
summary: A fake job ad in the name of a petroleum company promised 90,000 to 180,000 FCFA a month in seven cities and sent applicants to a WhatsApp link.
example_message: Offre d'emploi. La sociétés Bocom recherche des personnes âgées de 28 à 45 ans résidants dans les villes de Dschang, Douala, Kribi, Garoua, Bafoussam, Yaoundé et Bertoua avec un salaire de base allant de 90.000 à 180.000 par mois pour des services : d'entretien , réception dans des Pompiste, comptable, Architecte, serveuse, secrétariat bureautique, Chef service, Manager du stand, Gestionnaire du Stock, Assistant (e), Logistique et transport, Caissières, Chauffeurs. NB: le travail débutera de 8h30 à 17h30 https:// suivre le lien//wa[.]me/message/DPQ6CR54J4WOH1

title: CANULAR : Le MINFOPRA n'a pas lancé ce recrutement de 9 000 enseignants
summary: A fake 'special recruitment' of 9,000 teachers (10,000 further down the same notice) asked for applications by email to a Gmail address posing as the ministry.
example_message: Rentrée scolaire 2026/2027. Recrutement spéciale de 9 000 jeunes enseignants dans la fonction publique sur très hautes instructions du Président de la République. Le ministre de la Fonction publique et de la Réforme administrative (MINFOPRA) informe le public camerounais qu'un recrutement de dix mille (10 000) jeunes enseignants est ouvert sur l'ensemble du territoire national

title: CANULAR : Razel-Bec n'a lancé aucune campagne de recrutement au Cameroun
summary: A 'mass recruitment' of 650 civil engineering workers circulated with a document and an email address not belonging to the company, which denied it, noting such fakes recur.

title: CANULAR : MTN Cameroun n'offre pas 26 000 FCFA pour son 26e anniversaire
summary: A fake anniversary survey promised 26,000 FCFA from MTN; MTN said it ran no such survey.
example_message: Félicitations! MTN – Cadeau 26e anniversaire. Participez à notre sondage spécial 26e anniversaire et gagnez 26 000 FCFA offerts par MTN!

title: CANULAR : La marque Tangui n'offre pas 30 000 FCFA pour son anniversaire
summary: A questionnaire promised 30,000 FCFA in the name of a mineral water brand's anniversary; the company disowned it.
example_message: Source Tangui – Célébration Anniversaire. Remplissez ce questionnaire et gagnez 30 000 FCFA …

title: CANULAR : MTN Cameroun n'offre pas 35 000 FCFA pour son anniversaire
summary: Another anniversary survey promised up to 35,000 FCFA from MTN.
example_message: MTN – Célébration Anniversaire. Participez à cette enquête pour recevoir jusqu'à 35 000 FCFA pendant la célébration …

title: CANULAR : Orange n'offre pas 10 000 francs pour la fête du Travail
summary: A Labour Day 'gift' page asked people to share it in five groups or with 15 WhatsApp friends before 'receiving' 10,000 FCFA.
example_message: Célébrons la Fête du Travail le 1er mai. Peu importe ton réseau, fais une transaction Orange Money et reçois 10 000 F CFA. Orange Money célèbre la Fête du Travail. Cliquez sur le bouton "Obtenir" ci-dessous pour recevoir 10 000 XAF offerts par Orange Money pour la Fête du Travail

title: CANULAR : Les Aéroports du Cameroun n'ont pas lancé un recrutement de 250 stagiaires
summary: A fake paid-internship drive at the country's airports targeted pupils, students and job seekers.
example_message: ADC lance pour 2026 un recrutement rémunéré de 250 stagiaires et agents, ouvert aux élèves, étudiants et chercheurs d'emploi, pour ses aéroports de Douala, Yaoundé, Garoua (…)

title: CANULAR : Santa Lucia n'a lancé aucune campagne de recrutement de 520 jeunes
